summary: Asking for a table comparison or application status comparison between two service codes triggers an unhandled NameError: name '_ccrows' is not defined at line 18537 of backend/services/chatbot.py, immediately returning HTTP 500.
preconditions: Any comparison query mentioning 'table', 'status', or application counts matching _calc_qa._CMP_CODES in _calc_turn (e.g., 'Compare 0153 and 0154 applications in a table', 'which service code has more applications, 0153 or 0154?').
reproduction: Call _calc_turn('compare 0153 and 0154 applications', 'test-sess', officer, db, []).
Reproduced synchronously via SIS_ServiceCode_FileDB_Regression_Tests/test_service_code_calc_crash_regression.py: raises NameError: name '_ccrows' is not defined.
expected: The chatbot should query get_all_service_code_applications and render a comparison table via _calc_qa.compare_codes.
actual: Line 18537 attempts to call _calc_qa.compare_codes(text, _ccrows, ta) before _ccrows is assigned.
root_cause: Variable _ccrows was referenced at line 18537 before its definition at line 18544, resulting in a fatal Python NameError and session crash.
fix_description: In backend/services/chatbot.py lines 18528–18545, initialized _ccrows prior to line 18537 and guarded save_chat_messages with if db. Verified via test_service_code_calc_crash_regression.py.

summary: Typing a follow-up explanation request with typos or colloquial phrasing ('explian in detial', 'explain briefly') triggers an unhandled NameError: name 'tokens' is not defined at line 1261 of backend/services/chatbot.py, immediately crashing the session.
preconditions: User sends a follow-up message reaching _is_explain_request where fuzzy token typo matching is attempted.
reproduction: Call chatbot._is_explain_request('explian in detial').
Reproduced in test_servicecode_explain_followup.py and test_service_code_calc_crash_regression.py: raises NameError: name 'tokens' is not defined.
expected: _is_explain_request should extract alphanumeric tokens and test if any token matches _DETAIL_REQUEST_TRIGGER_WORDS within edit distance.
actual: Line 1261 iterates over tokens without initializing tokens = re.findall(r'[a-zA-Z]+', message or '') in _is_explain_request, crashing with NameError.
root_cause: Local variable tokens was omitted in the scope of _is_explain_request, leaving tokens unassigned.
fix_description: In backend/services/chatbot.py line 1236, initialized tokens = re.findall(r'[a-zA-Z]+', message or '') before evaluating trigger words. Verified via test_service_code_calc_crash_regression.py.

summary: A 'difference between A and B' / 'are A and B the same' question phrased with official service names (not raw 4-digit codes) resolves BOTH services for only 34 of 406 distinct pairs (8.4%). For 372 pairs (91.6%), it collapses to a single service or None.
preconditions: Exhaustive deterministic sweep over all 406 pairs in SIS_URBAN_SERVICES asking 'What is the difference between <name A> and <name B>?'.
reproduction: Full sweep recorded in SIS_All_Service_Code_Comparison_Matrix.csv (406 rows).
Live UI: 'What is the difference between Modification / Anadeenam and Addition?' -> names only 0158, 0159 dropped.
Live UI: 'What is the difference between Govt to Private and Settlement Govt to Private?' -> names only 0179, 0169 dropped.
Automated in SIS_ServiceCode_FileDB_Regression_Tests/test_all_servicecode_pairwise_resolution.py.
expected: Both named services should be resolved so a genuine pairwise comparison can be formed.
actual: Only 34 pairs resolve both codes. For 372 pairs (91.6%), find_service_code_by_name treats the sentence as a single word pool and returns at most one winner.
root_cause: find_service_code_by_name() scores the entire message against each service code and refuses ties. find_service_codes() only recovers a second code using _SVC_NAME_ALIASES (which covers only 4 of 29 codes).
fix_description: In backend/utils/helpers.py, added _build_catalogue_service_phrases() and _all_catalogue_service_codes(text) across all 29 services, plus comparative clause splitting on delimiters ('and', 'vs', 'versus', 'to', 'மற்றும்'). Pairwise resolution jumped from 34/406 (8.4%) to 406/406 (100.0%). Verified via test_all_servicecode_pairwise_resolution.py.

summary: The single winner selected by the fallback name resolution depends arbitrarily on question phrasing: the same pair (0158, 0159) resolves to 0158 on difference questions, but flips to 0159 on 'Are they the same?' questions.
preconditions: Asking questions about the pair 0158 and 0159.
reproduction: Live UI: 'What is the difference between Modification / Anadeenam and Addition?' -> names 0158.
Live UI: 'Are Modification and Addition the same?' -> names 0159.
expected: Consistent identification of both services regardless of grammatical framing.
actual: Winner flips based on incidental tokens ('difference between' vs 'the same') skewing keyword match ratios.
root_cause: Keyword scoring ratio is computed across the entire token stream including sentence operators, causing spurious score swings.
fix_description: Replaced global single-winner keyword ratio scoring in find_service_codes with exact non-overlapping span matching and comparative clause decomposition, ensuring both codes are deterministically resolved regardless of phrasing. Verified via test_all_servicecode_pairwise_resolution.py.

summary: 27 of 29 service codes have NO documented fee, SLA, or workflow chain anywhere in the application source code or authoritative documents. Only 0153 and 0154 have full documented attributes.
preconditions: Inspecting backend/utils/helpers.py (SIS_SERVICE_CODE_DETAIL) and backend/documents/land_rules.txt ('SERVICE FEE AND SLA BY SERVICE CODE').
reproduction: Grep across all documents in backend/documents/ for fee/SLA data of codes other than 0153/0154: zero entries exist.
Only name, category, and requires_field_visit are established for the other 27 codes.
expected: Pairwise comparisons asking about fee, SLA, or workflow for any pair outside {0153, 0154} must explicitly declare these attributes as 'not documented' rather than fabricating values or assuming equality.
actual: Previously unhandled: if pairwise resolution succeeded, LLM or naive handlers were at risk of hallucinating fee/SLA attributes.
root_cause: Authoritative government rules in repository only specify fees and SLA for NISD and ISD patta transfers. Other urban services lack fee/workflow specs.
fix_description: In backend/services/chatbot.py:_build_service_code_comparison_response and _all_service_code_comparison_answer, enforced strict grounding: statutory fees and SLAs are documented exclusively for 0153 and 0154. For all other 27 codes, explicitly outputs 'Not documented in departmental guidelines' or 'Fees, SLAs, and workflow stages for these service codes are not documented in current departmental guidelines', eliminating hallucination.

summary: _build_service_code_comparison_response contains rich domain comparison logic hardcoded EXCLUSIVELY for {0178, 0185}. For all other 405 pairs: 'BOTH' mode drops differences, table format is ignored, 'AMBIGUOUS_COMPARISON' fails to clarify, and 'IDENTITY_CHECK' dumps full descriptions.
preconditions: Any pairwise comparison query between valid codes other than 0178 and 0185 (e.g. 0153 vs 0154, 0158 vs 0159).
reproduction: _build_service_code_comparison_response(['0153', '0154'], 'Show both similarities and differences between 0153 and 0154') -> returns ONLY similarity sentence, drops differences.
_build_service_code_comparison_response(['0153', '0154'], 'Show only the differences between 0153 and 0154 in a table') -> ignores table, returns plain text bullets.
_build_service_code_comparison_response(['0153', '0154'], 'What is not the difference between 0153 and 0154?') -> fails to ask clarification.
Automated in SIS_ServiceCode_FileDB_Regression_Tests/test_pairwise_comparison_architectural_disparity.py.
expected: Uniform comparison handling across all pairs: render tables when requested, include both sections for 'BOTH', clarify ambiguous negation, and provide direct yes/no for identity checks.
actual: Lines 1366-1540 hardcode these features strictly for 0178 vs 0185. Lines 1541-1561 execute a primitive 1-sentence fallback for all other 405 pairs.
root_cause: Hardcoded if-branch `if '0178' in exact and '0185' in exact:` rather than a generalized attribute-comparison engine.
fix_description: Replaced hardcoded {0178, 0185} logic in _build_service_code_comparison_response with a universal domain comparison engine supporting all 406 pairs across DIFFERENCES, SIMILARITIES, BOTH, IDENTITY_CHECK, AMBIGUOUS_COMPARISON, and Markdown tables. Verified via test_pairwise_comparison_architectural_disparity.py.

summary: Catalog-wide comparison queries across all service codes have no dedicated intent or handler, causing them to misroute to all_service_code_applications, pending_applications, application_status, or unhandled general_query.
preconditions: User asks whole-catalog questions: 'Show similarities across all service codes', 'Compare all supported service codes', 'List attributes that apply to all services'.
reproduction: parse_intent('Show the similarities across all service codes.') -> all_service_code_applications.
parse_intent('Show the differences across all service codes.') -> all_service_code_applications.
parse_intent('Create a comparison matrix for every service code.') -> all_service_code_applications.
parse_intent('List attributes that apply to all services.') -> pending_applications.
parse_intent('Which service codes cannot be compared because documentation is missing?') -> application_status.
parse_intent('Compare all supported service codes.') -> general_query.
Automated in SIS_ServiceCode_FileDB_Regression_Tests/test_all_service_comparison_routing.py.
expected: Whole-catalog comparison requests should route to a dedicated catalog comparison intent that summarizes common traits, differences, field visit breakdowns, and documentation levels across the 29 codes.
actual: Questions are captured by generic regexes for 'service code' or 'applications' and misrouted to application listings or single-application status lookups.
root_cause: Absence of an all_service_code_comparison intent in rag.py and missing deterministic catalog matrix generator in chatbot.py.
fix_description: Added _ALL_SERVICE_COMPARISON_RE and all_service_code_comparison intent in backend/services/rag.py, and implemented deterministic generator _all_service_code_comparison_answer in backend/services/chatbot.py handling full matrices, commonalities, differences, functional groupings, and missing documentation reports for all 29 codes. Verified across all 11 catalog questions via test_all_service_comparison_routing.py.
